_comment: THE PUBLISHED SET. 15 categories x 295 pairs x 2 arms = 8,850 rows: 4,425 distinct gold cases, each queried twice -- once under a perturbed caption, once as its own unperturbed control.

Equal allocation is deliberate: it makes the macro-average and the pooled rate the same number, so there is no weighting choice to defend and no way to move the headline by re-weighting. It is a chosen allocation, not an observed user distribution, and therefore not a forecast of production accuracy.

Run it freely -- that is the point. It was measured once while clean to produce the published number, and after publication it drifts into a tuning set as people iterate against it. That is the normal lifecycle of a published benchmark, not a defect.
Pair it with v2-negatives.json. A recall number reported without the invariant population is the half that flatters.
